Synopsis:
    Bitcoin surged ~30% recently, breaking a bearish trend of lower peaks. Key technical levels to watch: $71,781 (bull/bear line), $82,793 resistance (May high / near 61.8% Fibonacci), upside targets $90K and $97,867, downside risk toward $62,677 and $57,776. The rally was catalyzed by US Treasury doubling long-duration debt buybacks. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish signals are cited as a headwind.
